items.description: List of samdump2 extraction tasks. Each item is a flat map of task-specific parameters: system_file (path to Windows SYSTEM hive), sam_file (path to Windows SAM hive), output_file (destination for extracted hashes), description (optional comment for the script), debug (enable verbose debugging output). Each field corresponds to a real documented setting: system_file and sam_file are the two required positional arguments from SYNOPSIS; output_file maps to the -o file option; debug maps to the -d flag; description is a user-defined comment (not a command-line arg, but useful for templating metadata). The items field is a flat map, not a nested object schema, to comply with the requirement that default values are bare scalars or arrays, and nested structures are defined as flat field-name -> {type, default, description} maps within the items schema itself. However, since items is a list-of-objects, we define the object's fields here as a flat map. Note: The default for the list is an empty array. The individual fields within each list item have their own defaults as specified below.
